title: Potential reuse is not attained throughput
purpose: Compare the recorded N=1,8,64 workloads with the same [512,512] weights.
contract: Ideal arithmetic intensity is a traffic model, not measured memory traffic.
N=8 is a retained negative result; overhead/cache causes remain hypotheses.
